name: Borrowed Umbrella
text: You need not follow suit on tricks your partner leads.

signature.target: your plays to tricks your partner leads

archetypes: Discard Dominance, Nil Champion, Blind Bidder
decision: On each trick your partner leads, whether to follow or shed a dangerous card or a void-opening card.
opponent: Visible when you play off suit; opponents answer by taking the lead away from your partner.
aiNote: On a relieved trick, play your highest non-spade card if on nil; otherwise play from your shortest non-spade suit.
rationale: Your partner leads about three tricks a round, and those are the leads least likely to catch a nil. It adds discards for Scouring Tornado without making following suit optional all round.
deviation: Revision 1: rewritten from relief on the trick after your partner wins one, which is the trick your partner leads.
